## How was it tested?

## Trunk-based checklist
- [ ] Branch is less than 1-2 days old and the PR is small (< ~300 lines)
- [ ] Unfinished work is behind a feature flag (OFF by default)
- [ ] Safe to deploy to prod straight after merge
- [ ] Rollback plan: flag off / revert this PR
